ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) base coverage exceeding 90% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters and linear streaks providing high-contrast localized deltas.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white mottle localized at the vertex of the median notch. Sparse high-intensity circular nodes distributed across the lower central fluke. Concentrated white linear markings localized primarily on the right lobe and central transition zone.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a wide internal angle approximately 100 degrees; deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations of 5-15 pixels along the entire trailing boundary. Irregular macro-scale protrusions on the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-angled points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple clusters of high-intensity, roughly circular pixel nodes visible in the lower-left and lower-central regions, representing localized contrast anomalies.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the central fluke vertically and the right lobe in various diagonal orientations.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent multi-colored (pink/tan/brown) high-texture bulbous mass attached to the terminus of the right lobe tip; smaller secondary cluster visible on the left lobe tip terminus.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive series of parallel vertical white lines concentrated at the lower-central fluke midline.
